name: cavemio-wallet
title: Wallet
description: A balance you can send from: the balance panel turns into the transfer, the button goes Sending → Sent, and the money visibly leaves.

cavemio.accessibility:
- The transfer is a labelled group that takes focus when it opens; digits, the decimal point, Backspace, Enter and Escape work from the keyboard anywhere in the card.
- People are a radio group while choosing who to pay, and buttons ("Send to Iris") on the home view.
- The balance and the amount are read as whole numbers from sr-only text, never digit by digit; sent and requested are announced from a status region beside the card.
- Errors are alerts and keep what you typed. While a transfer is pending the card can’t be cancelled.
- Its light comes from your theme: the card mixes --primary-foreground into --primary for the lit corner, 1px edges catch the light, and avatar tints come from --chart-1 to --chart-5, so it takes on your colours in light and dark. No drop shadows, glow or blur.
- Built from Number roll, Text morph, Status button and Copy button, which the CLI installs with it. No animation library; with reduced motion the card and rows change in place.
cavemio.previewNote: Interactive local fixture. Data and async results are simulated in the preview; the caller supplies application services.

props.name: balance
props.description: – · The available balance in major units. Changes roll in the direction they moved.

props.name: transactions
props.description: [] · Newest first: { id, title, date, amount, status?, src?, icon? }. Negative amounts are money out; status "pending" shows a request until it’s "paid"; icon puts a merchant’s logo on a tinted tile.

props.name: contacts
props.description: [] · People to pay or ask: { id, name, src? }. Without a photo, initials on a tint from your chart colours, the same tint for the same person everywhere.

props.name: onSend
props.description: – · Move the money; resolve when it’s done, throw an Error to show its message.

props.name: onRequest
props.description: – · Ask for money; resolve once the request exists and add it to transactions as pending.

props.name: name
props.description: "You" · The account holder, on the card.

props.name: label / last4
props.description: "Balance" / — · What the account is called, at the top of the card, and the last four digits, shown masked.

props.name: currency / locale
props.description: "USD" / browser · Formats every amount with Intl, including the decimal key on the keypad.

props.name: paymentLink
props.description: – · Shown with a copy button while requesting.

props.name: hidden / defaultHidden / onHiddenChange
props.description: — / false · Whether the balance is masked; controlled or not.

props.name: visibleTransactions
props.description: 2 · Rows of Activity before See all.

features.title: The panel becomes the transfer
features.description: Send and Request turn the balance panel into the amount you type, with no modal on top of the card.

features.title: Amounts typed safely
features.description: Digits are kept as text, two decimals at most, from the keypad or the keyboard (Enter sends, Escape cancels).

features.title: The button says what happens
features.description: It reads "Send $40.00" or why it can’t yet, then Sending, Sent with a drawn check, or Try again.

features.title: You see where the money went
features.description: After it’s sent the balance rolls down by the amount and the payment slides into Activity.

features.title: Requests until they’re paid
features.description: A request shows as a pending row; when you mark it paid the label morphs and the balance rolls up.

features.title: Your server stays in charge
features.description: Balance and history come from your props; onSend and onRequest do the work and their errors are shown in place.

states.title: home
states.description: A card-shaped panel in your --primary, lit from its top corner and engraved with fine fine lines, holds the account, the available balance, the holder and the last four digits; Request and Send sit under it, then the people you pay often and the latest two rows of Activity (See all opens the rest in place).

states.title: hidden
states.description: The eye folds the balance into dots through a 6px blur; "Available" while sending is masked too.

states.title: send / request
states.description: The card turns into the transfer in 460ms: the title morphs ("Send to Iris"), the typed amount rolls open place by place, the actions and Activity fold away and the keypad, note and button fold in.

states.title: pending
states.description: The button morphs to Sending with a spinner; the keypad and people are locked until it settles.

states.title: sent
states.description: A check draws itself, the panel turns back, then the balance rolls down and the new row slides in at the top of Activity.

states.title: error
states.description: Your error message replaces the hint under the amount, the button shakes and reads Try again; the amount and note are kept.

states.title: paid
states.description: A pending request whose status turns paid morphs "Requested" into "Paid" and the balance rolls up.
